data.name: Nusayba
data.gender_notes: Nusayba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who fights for a cause, a brave and strong warrior. The name Nusayba carries the meaning “fighter, warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nusayba usually hope their child will grow to embody fighter, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a strong and fearless woman who is ready to fight for her beliefs and values.
data.etymology: Nusayba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “fighter, warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nusayba total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: نُسَيْبَة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الذكية أو العاقلة أو الحكيمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نُسَيْبَة هو اسم مؤنث عربي مشتق من كلمة 'نسابة' التي تعني الشخص الذي يهتم بتحليل الأنساب والأصول. يعتبر اسم نُسَيْبَة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الذكاء والحكمة والعقلانية. في بعض المراجع، يرتبط الاسم بمعاني أخرى مثل 'المتفوقة' أو 'المتقدمة'. وقد ورد ذكر اسم نُسَيْبَة في بعض المصادر التاريخية كاسم لأم رفيقة بنت أبي الحسين، وهي من الشخصيات المعروفة في التاريخ الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: نسیبہ
in_urdu.meaning: ذہین، عقلمند، حکیمہ، نسابہ سے مشتق
in_urdu.long_meaning: نسیبہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے ذہین، عقلمند یا حکیمہ۔ یہ نام نسابة سے مشتق ہے، جو وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو انساب اور أصول کا تجزیہ کرنے کا شوق رکھتا ہو۔ اسلامی تقليد میں، یہ نام ذہانت، حکمت، اور عقلانيت کی صفات سے وابستہ ہے۔ تاريخي طور پر، یہ نام بعض اہم الشخصيات سے منسلک ہے، جیسے کہ ام رفیقة بنت ابی الحسین، جو اسلامی تاريخ میں معروف ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: नुसैबा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नुसैबा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमान, समझदार या बुद्धिमत्ता से युक्त। यह नाम 'नसाबा' से व्युत्पन्न है, जो व्यक्ति की वंशावली और मूल का विश्लेषण करने वाले को कहते हैं। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम बुद्धिमत्ता, ज्ञान और समझदारी के गुणों से जुड़ा है। ऐतिहासिक रूप से, यह नाम कुछ महत्वपूर्ण हस्तियों से जुड़ा है, जैसे कि उम्म रफीका बिन्त अबी अल-हुसैन, जो इस्लामी इतिहास में प्रसिद्ध हैं।

in_pashto.name: نسيبه
in_pashto.long_meaning: نسيبه د ښځينو یو نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. د دې نوم معنی هوښیار، ځيره یا پوهه ده. دا نوم د 'نسابة' څخه مشتق شوی دی، کوم چې د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چې د خاندان او نسب په اړه پوهه لري. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د پوهې، حکمت او ځيرنې صفاتو سره تړلی دی. تاريخي پلوه، دا نوم د ځينو مهمو شخصيتونو سره تړاو لري، لکه د ام رفیقة بنت ابی الحسین، چې په اسلامي تاريخ کې مشهوره ده.

in_english.name: Nusayba
in_english.meaning: Intelligent, wise, knowledgeable, derived from Arabic root 'N-S-B'
in_english.long_meaning: Nusayba is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'N-S-B', which means 'to relate by blood' or 'lineage'. The name signifies intelligence, wisdom, and knowledge. In Islamic tradition, Nusayba is associated with virtues like understanding, insight, and sagacity. Historically, Nusayba bint al-Haris, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, bore this name. Across Muslim cultures, Nusayba remains a popular name for girls, symbolizing positive attributes such as intellect and discernment.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nusayba evokes a sense of courage, bravery, and determination. In Islamic history, there was a woman named Nusayba bint Ka'ab who was a prominent companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was known for her exceptional courage and bravery during the Battle of Uhud. Nusayba and her two sons fought extensively during the battle against the enemy, and she is said to have transfixed an enemy soldier with her eyes, rendering him incapable of fighting. The name Nusayba symbolizes strength, valor, and the ability to fight fearlessly for a worthy cause.
data.spiritual_significance: Nusayba holds a significant spiritual meaning as well. It emphasizes the importance of possessing a strong and unwavering faith in God and being willing to fight for His cause. As mentioned earlier, Nusayba bint Ka'ab is an excellent example of this. Her bravery and courage were not for any personal gain, but rather for the sake of defending her faith and community. The name Nusayba represents the drive and determination to stand up for one's beliefs and to use one's abilities and strengths to serve a higher purpose, in accordance with Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nusayba: Dedicated to the cause of truth and steadfast in faith, Nusayba embodies the unwavering commitment of a believer, inspiring courage and perseverance. Her name, meaning "support," symbolizes the strong foundation of faith that holds one steady amidst life's trials and tribulations.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Sa'd, Kitab al-Tabaqat al-Kabir, Volume 2, Page 184 The name Nusayba carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Nusayba bint Ka'ab was a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was a Bedouin from the Banu Asad clan and embraced Islam before the migration to Medina. During the Battle of Uhud in 625 AD (3 AH), Nusayba was among the few Muslim women who participated in the battle. She fought bravely and killed a man from the enemy ranks, inspiring the Muslim army. Her heroic deeds earned her the nickname 'Dhul-Jihadain' (the possessor of two battles) and she became a role model for Muslim women.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn al-Athir, Al-Kamil fi al-Tarikh, Volume 3, Page 235 The name Nusayba carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Nusayba bint Ka'ab is also known as the founder of the Nusayri sect, a heterodox offshoot of Islam that emerged in the 9th century AD (2 AH) in Syria. The Nusayri belief system is characterized by a complex hierarchy of saints, the veneration of certain places and relics, and a messianic expectation. Nusayba supposedly received divine revelations and formed a following around her teachings, leading to the establishment of the Nusayri community. However, her status as the founder of the sect is a subject of debate among scholars and legends surrounding her life have been embellished over time.

modern_usage.modern_context: Nusayba bint Ka'ab (594-640 CE) was a prominent female figure in early Islamic history who participated in the Battle of Uhud (625 CE) and was celebrated for her courage and devotion to Islam. Today, her story is increasingly recognized and explored in various contexts. In academic journals, scholars continue to research Nusayba's life, role in Islamic history, and impact on early Muslim society. On social media platforms, Nusayba is often highlighted as an inspiring figure for women and girls, particularly in discussions about women's roles in Islam and gender equality. Blogs and websites dedicated to Islamic history and women's studies also feature Nusayba as an important example of a female warrior and role model. Her story serves as a reminder of the significant contributions women made during the formative years of Islam and continues to resonate with contemporary audiences.
